title: Navimower 0.4.3-beta30

# Navimower 0.4.3-beta30

## Custom Areas import experiment

- Adds the first experimental **Custom areas** workflow under the integration Configure/gear-icon options.
- `Add custom area` first captures the current Navimow map revision and off-limit geometry as a baseline.
- The user then creates and saves exactly one temporary off-limit area in the Navimow app. `Detect` refreshes the map immediately and identifies the newly added polygon by geometry rather than by vendor list index.
- Polygon matching is stable when the vendor changes the starting vertex or reverses clockwise/counter-clockwise point order.
- The detected polygon is copied into NaviMower with its own persistent ID and user-selected name. The Custom Area remains stored after the temporary off-limit area is deleted from the Navimow app.
- Custom Areas can also be deleted from the same options menu; this only removes NaviMower's local virtual area and never writes to the mower map.

This beta intentionally stops at **creation/import/storage** so the workflow can be field-tested first. It does not yet expose a Custom Area occupancy sensor or alter cutting height/work mode. Those behaviors can be added on top of the same persistent polygon model after import is proven reliable.
